_comment: Verifier profiles. The verifier parent never imports candidate code. It checks out the EXACT revision privately, rejects the diff statically (protected/editable paths, hook files, stdlib/verifier shadowing, non-source/bytecode/binary/symlink files, non-UTF-8 encodings and the static_scan AST tripwire), purges bytecode, and spawns UNTRUSTED children with -I, -B, a throwaway pycache_prefix and a scrubbed env (no secret, nonce or result path anywhere in a process that imports candidate code). oracle profiles (required for fixture-*): the parent sends fresh random inputs one at a time to oracle_child.py and recomputes every expected value from omo_grok/oracles.py (assurance=oracle). The unittest_child.py run of expected_tests is advisory: a negative report fails, a positive one proves nothing alone. Profiles without an oracle are assurance=cooperative (forgeable by adversarial code; independent code_review and qa on the same revision are required). Non-python profiles need exit_code_only: true. OMO_VERIFY_TEMPLATE anywhere fails closed.
